report.question: How can variational block responses replace pointwise ellipticity so that finite-range high-contrast media reach a fixed small coarse contrast after only C(d) log^2(1+Theta) triadic scales?
report.reading_scope: Read the complete main TeX ICM-forarxiv.tex (1960 lines), its bibliography and relevant definitions/macros from the exact 2509.24887v1 source archive. Read versioned abstract/HTML metadata. This includes §§1.1-1.2, §§2.1-2.3, §3 and all stated lemmas and proofs in the short report. No PDF pixel inspection and no successful reading of the SIAM full text. The 152-page underlying paper 2405.10732v3 was read only in the targeted ranges listed under source_records, not in full.
report.coverage_status: 42 atomic pages (4001-400Z and 4010-4016), narrative 4000 and one reference, with every atom linked from the narrative. Following Noether's P1 on the 400S fine-scale tail, 400S/400X/400Y/400Z/4010 and the overview were revised using deterministic microscopic bounds lambda and Lambda. Every restart retains the same Theta=Lambda/lambda. The local fixed-tolerance logarithmic-square derivation is supplied conditional on the cited localization/multiplier inputs; Noether subsequently reread the five repaired proof pages and confirmed that the mathematical P1 can be closed; final record/hash refresh remains pending. proof_scope.4001: Defines uniformly elliptic symmetric weak equations and Dirichlet data using existing Sobolev definitions. No extra boundary trace theorem is assumed.
proof_scope.4002: Coordinate averaging, one-dimensional integration and reflection/mollification give the cube mean-zero Poincare proof.
proof_scope.4003: Full Hilbert-space proof of real, possibly nonsymmetric Lax-Milgram; minimization conclusion restricted to symmetric forms.
proof_scope.4005: Construction, existence, linearity and minimizing property proved in the uniformly elliptic setting.
proof_scope.4006: Variational Neumann construction and solvability proved; no boundary trace theorem invoked.
proof_scope.4007: Joint quadratic formula proved from both boundary problems.
proof_scope.4008: Full first-variation and quadratic-functional difference proof. The correct identity uses J-F(w), not J minus the bare positive energy; independent countercheck and source discrepancy recorded only in source_errata.
proof_scope.4009: Exact additivity-defect identity and both matrix subadditivities proved.
proof_scope.4010: Fixed tolerance: at most C log(2Theta) rounds, each costing C log(2Theta), with factor 1/4 and a last step padded to every larger N. The corrected directly derived arbitrary-tolerance remainder is C sigma^-4 log(2/sigma) log(2Theta/sigma), including the unchanged microscopic Theta. The sharper original tolerance term in 400P remains a citation. Localization/multiplier inputs remain external; Noether subsequently confirmed the corrected iteration and tolerance cost.
proof_scope.4011: Exact scaling conversion including physical correlation length.
proof_scope.4012: Monotone-limit argument only; not a qualitative replacement for the scale theorem.
proof_scope.4013: Full trace/Markov proof; explicit finite-block quantifiers.
proof_scope.4014: Precisely cited symmetric H1 specialization of arXiv:2405.10732v3 Proposition 5.3; the equality of the two-variable defect and the symmetric one-variable defect is proved. Fractional boundary duality is described, not reproduced.
proof_scope.4015: Open problems and conditional algebra only; no percolation exponent asserted as proved.
proof_scope.4016: Pairing telescoping argument supplied; fractional Poincare/multiplier theorem precisely quoted as external input.
proof_scope.400A: All order bounds proved; distinguishes trial-function lower bound from pointwise upper bound.
proof_scope.400B: Both inequalities proved with their distinct domains.
proof_scope.400D: Exact model calculation; not a multidimensional stochastic theorem.
proof_scope.400E: Defines only the explicit block norm and proves constant-function normalization.
proof_scope.400F: Exact square-root/square normalization preserved; deterministic bounds proved.
proof_scope.400G: Both estimates proved, including normalization and domains.
proof_scope.400H: Cutoff proof with absorption and volume factor.
proof_scope.400I: Exact statement and detailed argument structure; mesoscopic localization proof cited.
proof_scope.400J: Definition and noncommutative algebraic identity proved.
proof_scope.400K: Full blockwise proof, with explicit c_(2s) factor instead of an unsupported uniform-in-s constant.
proof_scope.400L: Completion and local integrability explained; avoids claiming L1-based displayed norm is an inner-product norm.
proof_scope.400M: Exact local sigma-field formulation and finite coloring explained.
proof_scope.400N: Scalarization proved under signed-coordinate symmetry and the explicit finite-moment assumption E||A(Q_m)||+E||B(Q_m)||<infinity. Deterministic uniform ellipticity is stated as sufficient. Ordinary permutations alone are shown insufficient.
proof_scope.400O: Correct annealed inverse, Jensen order and theta monotonicity; no unproved T monotonicity.
proof_scope.400P: Exact reported theorem cited; local proof chain derives fixed-tolerance result and a weaker explicit tolerance remainder.
proof_scope.400Q: Full numerical proof with exact window length.
proof_scope.400R: Full combinatorial proof for fixed even moments.
proof_scope.400S: Uniformly elliptic fixed-exponent estimate using the direct fine-tail bound c_nu sum_(n<=0) 3^-nu(m-n) max_Q ||X(Q)||^(1/2) <= M^(1/2)3^-nu m, with deterministic M=lambda^-1 or Lambda. The resulting positive-part and L/U errors use those deterministic bounds, and T_(j+m)<=theta_j+C3^-rho m Theta at every restart. The earlier max/sum exchange and stronger local-T0 remainder have been withdrawn; Noether subsequently confirmed this mathematical repair.
proof_scope.400T: Exact usable inequality with proof structure; Besov multiplier input cited.
proof_scope.400U: Four-term decomposition derived; both gradient and flux substitutions specified.
proof_scope.400V: Full trace-plus-concentration estimate, slightly stronger j-decay than the weakened printed bound.
proof_scope.400X: Uses the deterministic Theta-based threshold C log(2Theta/delta), pointwise J and D <=Theta, rho=13/64, eta=3/64 and four explicit absorption conditions. Derives both centered estimates with the corrected 400S positive-part bounds; no reliance on the withdrawn local-T0 cost.
proof_scope.400Y: Deduction from localization and centered estimates at the corrected threshold C log(2Theta/delta), retaining the original deterministic microscopic Theta.
proof_scope.400Z: One-step bound derived with cost C sigma^-4 log(2/sigma) log(2Theta/sigma). The final restoration uses theta_(N-h)+C3^-rho h Theta. Every spatial restart keeps the same lambda, Lambda and Theta.

local_revision_findings.finding: The earlier estimate replaced sum_n max_z by max_z sum_n in the wrong direction. Monotonicity in the fine-scale index does not justify that exchange.
local_revision_findings.algebraic_countercheck: For normalized weights c_nu 3^(nu n), n<=0, let one block sequence be 1 and another be epsilon for -h<n<=0 and 3^(nu h) for n<=-h. Both are positive and nondecreasing toward finer scales. The maximum of their weighted sums is 1+epsilon(1-3^-nu h), while the weighted sum of their pointwise maximum is 2-3^-nu h, strictly larger for 0<epsilon<1, h>0. This tests the algebraic inference, not realizability by a particular PDE coefficient.
local_revision_findings.repair: Bound every fine-scale matrix by deterministic M=lambda^-1 or Lambda. The normalized fine tail is then <=3^-nu m sqrt(M). Derive R_m and positive-part moment bounds with this M; retain the same microscopic Theta at all restarts. Rewrite the centered estimates, flat-window threshold, one-step cost and final iteration accordingly.
